name: eeoom GEO – AI Search Optimization
author: eeoom

sections.description:
eeoom GEO helps WordPress site owners prepare, optimize and monitor their websites for AI search, generative answer engines and entity-based discovery.

The plugin combines GEO readiness checks, entity signal optimization, structured data improvements and visibility-oriented workflows. It is designed to support the full AI search optimization process: from basic technical readiness and machine-readable entity signals to visibility monitoring, competitor insights and content recommendations.

eeoom GEO does not replace your SEO plugin. Instead, it works alongside supported SEO plugins and extends the website’s GEO foundation when compatible data and schema output are available.

What the plugin does

  • Helps improve a website’s GEO foundation for AI search and generative answer engines.
  • Strengthens machine-readable entity signals for the organization behind a website.
  • Enhances supported Organization schema with additional trust, location, expertise and relationship signals.
  • Provides manual readiness checks for published public URLs.
  • Stores the latest check status and score for checked posts and pages.
  • Provides the foundation for broader AI visibility workflows, competitor insights and content recommendations.
  • Detects supported SEO plugin integrations.

Current features

  • eeoom GEO overview inside WordPress admin.
  • Manual URL checks for published posts and pages.
  • Sends only the selected public URL when a check is manually started.
  • Drafts, private posts and preview URLs are never sent.
  • Supported SEO plugin detection.
  • Optional Organization schema enhancements.
  • Add sameAs profile URLs.
  • Add hasMap URL.
  • Add PostalAddress fields.
  • Add areaServed values.
  • Add knowsAbout topics.
  • Add optional parentOrganization reference.
  • Add optional subOrganization references.
  • Cache notice for schema changes.
  • Stores last check status and score per post/page.
  • Supports asynchronous Source of Trust checks with polling.
  • Plugin Admin role management for selected WordPress users.
  • Capability-based access control for eeoom GEO features.

External service notice

This plugin connects to the Source of Trust API, provided by eeoom, to run manual GEO readiness, structured data and entity signal checks for published public URLs.

The service is used only when an authorized user manually starts a page check in the WordPress admin. The plugin sends the selected published public URL and a WordPress HTTP user agent to the Source of Trust API.

The API may process checks asynchronously. When a check is started, the plugin may receive a check job ID and then poll the Source of Trust API for the final result. The final result may include a status, score, issues and recommendations, which may be stored in WordPress post meta for the checked post or page.

The plugin does not send draft content, private content, preview URLs, post body content, visitor data, passwords or personal user data.

Service used:

  • Source of Trust API: https://sourceoftrust.com/api/v1/json-ld-check
  • Terms of Service: https://sourceoftrust.com/en/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://sourceoftrust.com/en/privacy

Schema integration

eeoom GEO can enhance existing Organization schema output generated by supported SEO plugins as one part of the broader GEO foundation. The initial integration supports Yoast SEO schema output.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Yoast.

The plugin does not replace your SEO plugin. The supported SEO plugin remains responsible for the base schema graph, including the Organization name, URL, logo and @id. eeoom GEO only adds selected additional fields when enabled.

Supported Organization enhancements:

  • sameAs
  • hasMap
  • address
  • areaServed
  • knowsAbout
  • parentOrganization
  • subOrganization

Yoast SEO is supported but not bundled with this plugin.

Cache notice

Schema enhancements are rendered into the page HTML. If your site uses a page caching plugin, CDN cache or server-side cache, clear the cache after changing schema settings so the updated schema can be published site-wide.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eeoom-source-of-trust directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to eeoom GEO to open the overview.
  4. Optional: Install and activate Yoast SEO.
  5. Go to eeoom GEO → Schema & Entity to enable Organization schema enhancements.
  6. Go to eeoom GEO → URL Checks to manually check published URLs.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace my SEO plugin?

No. eeoom GEO does not replace your SEO plugin. It adds selected Organization entity fields when supported schema output is available and the feature is enabled.

Does the plugin send my content to sourceoftrust.com?

No. Manual URL checks send only the public URL of the selected published post or page. Drafts, private posts, preview URLs, post body content and user data are not sent. The Source of Trust API returns a check job ID and, after processing, a result containing status, score, issues and recommendations.

Are checks automatic?

No. Checks are only started manually by an authorized WordPress user. If a check is processed asynchronously, the plugin polls the Source of Trust API until the result is available or the check fails.

Does this plugin work without Yoast SEO?

The overview and manual URL check features work without Yoast SEO. The initial schema enhancement integration affects Yoast SEO schema output only when Yoast SEO is active.

Will schema enhancements appear on every page?

The plugin enhances the Organization node wherever supported schema output includes that Organization node in the schema graph. It keeps the same Organization @id and adds consistent entity signals.

Do I need to clear my cache?

Yes, if your website uses page caching, CDN caching or server-side caching. Schema is rendered into the HTML, so cached pages may still show the old schema until the cache is cleared.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Improved URL Checks with a cleaner REST API based workflow and server-to-server Source of Trust API communication.
  • Improved persistent check status handling and stored check results per URL/page.
  • Improved the Structured Data Check report and URL Checks overview UI.
  • Added Plugin Admins with direct eeoom GEO capability assignment for selected users.
  • Prevented plugin administrators from accidentally removing their own access.
  • Improved the Settings page structure and responsive layout.

1.1.0

  • Redesigned the Schema Enhancements settings page for a clearer GEO workflow.
  • Improved the admin interface for managing Organization schema and entity signals.
  • Updated the plugin display name to eeoom GEO.
  • Improved plugin description and readme wording for AI search visibility.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Organization schema enhancements for supported schema output.
  • Added sameAs, hasMap, PostalAddress, areaServed and knowsAbout fields.
  • Added parentOrganization and subOrganization fields.
  • Added manual Source of Trust page checks.
  • Added asynchronous Source of Trust API checks with job ID polling.
